old_problem: The active record kept the case pending because the example's final MB/s unit is wrong and DeepSeek changes bandwidth into latency. The Master title, procedure and tool consistently establish bandwidth, while its general 90%-of-ideal rule is usable. Dimensional conversion is authoritative: 6400 Gbit/s divided by 8 equals 800 GB/s, and 90% equals 720 GB/s, not 720 MB/s. Actual acceptance must still bind to the verified Mellanox link or aggregate scope.

test_case.test_name: Mellanox P1 InfiniBand finite paired write-bandwidth test with dimensionally correct 90%-of-ideal oracle
test_case.purpose: Activate the approved Mellanox P1 in InfiniBand mode through a complete DC cycle and measure finite bidirectional ib_write_bw throughput against 90% of the verified link-specific or approved aggregate payload ideal using consistent units.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA MFT/firmware/OFED or rdma-core/perftest versions
Mellanox adapter serial/MST/BDF/P1/IB-device/GUID/GID/NUMA/peer/cable map and saved prior LINK_TYPE/network state
Approved /24 addresses, MTU, SM/fabric, negotiated rate/width and whether the intended ideal is per-port or an explicit multi-link aggregate
Finite ib_write_bw message/QP/depth/duration or iteration/repeat/statistic profile plus valid CPU 0-72 affinity
Approved payload-efficiency formula/overhead, decimal units, 90% threshold, OOB/DC-cycle and rollback plan
test_case.test_command: Verify the exact Mellanox adapter/P1/peer and save its current/next-boot LINK_TYPE/network state. At an approved hold point set `LINK_TYPE_P1=1`, perform the full DC OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready cycle, and prove active IB rate/width/MTU/GID with clean counters. Configure only approved /24 addresses, validate CPUs 0-72/NUMA, then run the literal paired taskset/ib_write_bw options on port 3000 under the approved finite profile and repeats. Compute the selected statistic in Gbit/s against 90% of the verified per-link or explicitly approved aggregate payload ideal. If 6400 Gbit/s is the approved ideal, record 800 GB/s and a 720 GB/s floor; never use 720 MB/s. Restore prior mode/network and verify post-health.
test_case.expected_result: The exact Mellanox P1 becomes active InfiniBand after the complete DC cycle, reaches the approved rate/width/MTU/GID state and remains error-free. Finite paired runs complete with matched parameters, and the approved statistic reaches at least 90% of the unit-consistent payload ideal. The result is reported under this row's independent source identity and prior mode/network is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable Mellanox target/peer identity, complete mode/DC/link evidence, finite raw paired outputs, valid affinity, explicit per-link-or-aggregate scope, and a unit-correct 90% calculation. 720 MB/s cannot pass the stated 6400-Gbit/s example. Without authoritative actual/aggregate link scope or payload formula the result is INCONCLUSIVE—not PASS.
safety_gate: Never change an unidentified/shared management port; require maintenance, OOB and explicit mutation/DC authorization
Prove pending/active LINK_TYPE and exact per-link versus aggregate scope before traffic
Bound bidirectional traffic and abort on link/fabric/thermal/RAS impact
Restore prior mode/network, preserve evidence and never substitute a latency tool or auto-retry
expected_evidence: Pinned stack and independent Mellanox adapter/P1/peer/GUID/GID/NUMA identity
mlxconfig before/pending/active and complete DC OFF/ON/OS-ready timeline
IB link rate/width/MTU/GID/fabric plus pre/post error counters
Exact finite paired commands/outputs/exits, affinity and repeat statistic
Per-link/aggregate ideal derivation, corrected units/90% floor, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: On mode, cycle, link or traffic failure, stop the benchmark, preserve state/counters and use OOB to restore the saved LINK_TYPE/network through the approved cycle. Verify fabric/manageability and do not switch metrics, change units or retry automatically.
